item.title: Step Conference 2026 in Dubai — The Hub of Innovation, Technology, and Startups - DESIGNER magazine
item.description: Step Conference 2026, held in Dubai on February 11-12, brought together over 8,000 participants, including startups, investors, and tech leaders. It focused on "Intelligence Everywhere: The AI Economy" and featured panel discussions, workshops, and networking opportunities. The event serves as a vital platform for innovation, investment, and collaboration in the Middle East tech ecosystem.

item.title: Poezja, która łączy, wyjątkowe wydarzenie literackie – Sztokholmski Salon Poezji - DESIGNER magazine
item.description: On March 7, the Stockholm Poetry Salon celebrated its 45th event, honoring poets Wisława Szymborska and Zbigniew Herbert. The performance titled “Chosen by the Stars” featured moving interpretations by artists Anna Dymna and Krzysztof Orzechowski, accompanied by music from Marek Dytłow. The event highlighted the enduring power of poetry to unite generations and cultures.

item.title: 65 Years of Women’s Solidarity – IWC Stockholm in Celebration - DESIGNER magazine
item.description: The International Women’s Club of Stockholm, founded in 1961, celebrates its 65th anniversary in March 2026. Initially created to support newcomers, it has grown into a diverse community of around 300 women from over 60 countries, fostering friendship, education, and philanthropy while making a tangible impact through small, meaningful actions.

item.title: Dubai Culture Celebrates Eid with Immersive Heritage Experiences - DESIGNER magazine
item.description: From March 20 to 24, 2026, Dubai Culture celebrates Eid Al-Fitr with cultural activities at Etihad and Al Shindagha Museums as part of the 'Eid in Dubai' campaign. Events include workshops, guided tours, culinary experiences, and traditional performances, aiming to highlight local heritage, community values, and togetherness during this festive season.

item.title: Women Changing the World Summit & Awards – Paris 2026 - DESIGNER magazine
item.description: The Women Changing the World Summit & Awards in Paris, April 2026, brings together women who inspire and enact change. Dr. Tererai Trent leads this initiative, promoting education and empowerment. The event emphasizes meaningful connections, support, and collaboration. Designer Magazine serves as a media partner, recognizing exceptional women contributing to societal transformation.

item.title: DESIGNER Magazine as Media Partner for Women Changing the World Global Summit & Awards - DESIGNER magazine
item.description: The Women Changing the World Summit & Awards is where visionary women come together to lead, inspire, and make a real impact. item.title: Luxury at the Speed of Culture – Miami Grand Prix 2026 - DESIGNER magazine
item.description: The Miami Grand Prix 2026 has evolved into a lifestyle event, blending Formula 1 racing with design, luxury, and culture. Central to this transformation is the Oracle Red Bull Racing presence, offering immersive experiences. Culinary excellence enhances the atmosphere, while the event serves as a vibrant meeting point for creatives and enthusiasts, redefining modern luxury.

item.title: Tigullio Design District 2026 - DESIGNER magazine
item.description: The Tigullio Design District 2026, commencing on April 18, showcases a blend of local and international design, emphasizing sustainability and maritime culture. Key events include fashion shows, exhibitions featuring Peruvian designers, and competitions focusing on nautical innovation. The initiative aims to enrich the Tigullio region through design dialogue and collaboration.

item.title: Tigullio Design District 2026 – A Week of Design on the Ligurian Coast - DESIGNER magazine
item.description: The Tigullio Design District 2026, held from April 20 to 26 in Italy's picturesque Riviera towns, celebrates design, architecture, and culture. The event includes exhibitions, conferences, and workshops focusing on sustainability and innovation, featuring both established and emerging talents. It culminates in a grand closing ceremony in Portofino, emphasizing creativity and collaboration.

item.title: Liguria Design Cultural Association - DESIGNER magazine
item.description: The Liguria Design Cultural Association, based in Chiavari, promotes design in Liguria on national and international levels. It supports creativity and craftsmanship through events, workshops, and exhibitions. The Tigullio Design District is a key initiative highlighting the region's design while fostering collaboration. Founded by experienced professionals, it connects diverse stakeholders in the design sector.
